title: Broad mixed-contract MGDA three-seed 65k curve
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Across three independent seeds, 65,536 hands per seed of twelve-objective MGDA against six behaviorally distinct learned opponents will retain Standard10 action competence and yield a positive 16k-to-65k untouched-holdout slope in at least two seeds, with nonnegative median final holdout and seat deltas.
material_change: Scale the validated restart-safe broad MGDA trainer to three seeds, eight 8,192-hand chunks per seed, 64 MGDA updates per chunk, and checkpoints at every chunk. Evaluate frozen checkpoints at 16,384, 32,768, and 65,536 hands on 512 matched pairs per each of three SHA-disjoint gradient-untouched holdouts, plus a 4,096-state Standard10 preservation panel. No Slumbot selection or external hands.
baseline: The 4,096-hand contract smoke passed all mechanism/resume gates with 100% Standard10 greedy agreement. Prior narrow MGDA had favorable internal slope but failed fresh20k at -47.525 bb/100, motivating broader untouched holdouts before external spend.
notes: Admission to 262,144 hands/seed requires every mechanism/integrity gate, positive 16k-to-65k pooled holdout slope in at least 2/3 seeds, nonnegative median final seed-holdout delta, nonnegative median final seed-seat delta, Standard10 overall agreement >=95%, and every seat/street partition >=90%. At this <=1M scale, negative absolute proxy values alone mean undertraining unless accompanied by adverse slope, proxy inversion, instability, or preservation collapse.

All 24 training chunks and all 55,296 matched evaluation trajectories completed. No Slumbot hands were used. Negative absolute internal values alone were not used as a stopping rule; the hold decision is driven by adverse replicated dose slopes plus a preregistered preservation miss.

result.summary: Three independent broad-MGDA seeds completed exactly 196,608 actual environment hands and 55,296 frozen holdout trajectories. All 1,536/1,536 MGDA updates had positive worst-group alignment and all integrity/resume/holdout-exclusion gates passed. Final median seed-holdout delta was +12.1104 bb/100 and median seed-seat delta +6.5179, but only seed1 had a positive 16k-to-65k slope (+0.22); seed0/2 were -21.45/-25.35. Seed2 Standard10 agreement was 94.5557%, below the 95% gate, while every seat/street partition remained >=92.0863%. All seeds reached the 0.25 residual cap; 248 tests passed.
result.conclusion: The broad twelve-objective MGDA mechanism is stable and its final cross-domain medians are encouraging, so the method is not rejected for insufficient absolute score. However the current 64-update-per-8k dose is not admitted to 262k: two of three untouched-holdout slopes are adverse and one seed crosses the source-preservation boundary while residuals saturate. The evidence points to update-dose/cap overtraining or checkpoint-boundary effects rather than a need for more hands under the unchanged schedule.
result.next_step: Audit every frozen 8,192-hand checkpoint on the fixed source panel and reuse the exact evaluation JSONL for paired per-seed/holdout/seat dose-slope CIs. Locate the first cap/preservation/holdout boundary, then preregister a lower-update-dose three-seed curve if the earlier boundary is coherent; otherwise close this MGDA schedule.
